data.name: Dark Resilience
data.description: The black blood flowing through a black-blooded oracle's veins gives her resistance to many effects to which undead are immune. %1 per day, as an immediate action, whenever she fails a saving throw against an ability drain, a death effect, disease, energy drain, paralysis, or poison, she may attempt that saving throw again with a +4 circumstance bonus. She must take the second result, even if it is worse.|1+(OracleLVL+1)/8
